name: Etemon
main_effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] By trashing 1 card with [Sukamon] in its name in your hand or in this Digimon's digivolution cards, until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP and gains ＜Security A. -1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.).
source_effect: [All Turns] When this Digimon would be deleted, by deleting 1 other Digimon with [Sukamon] in its name, prevent that deletion.
